valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: CMS retroactive audit ('CRUSH' rule) headwinds and slower Medicare Advantage margin recovery

base.driver: Gradual Medicare Advantage margin and Star Ratings recovery off the FY2026 ($9.50+ EPS) reset

bull.driver: Stronger-than-expected MA pricing discipline, utilization stability, and Star Ratings rebound

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $17.50, the $450.00 close implies 25.7x; the ~$515 consensus analyst target implies 29.4x (or $21.46 EPS at 24.0x).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $17.50 (3.9 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Medicare Advantage medical cost ratio (MCR) and CMS Star Ratings / retroactive audit ('CRUSH' rule) impact
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and FY2027 guidance (expected February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Humana's Q3 2026 earnings beat and FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance raise (to at least $9.50) on Nov 6, 2026, Wells Fargo ($602), Barclays ($587), Piper Sandler ($526), and Guggenheim ($521) all raised their targets and reiterated Buy/Overweight ratings. Street targets sit ~21 pp above our $420.00 base case (-6.7% vs. close), implying either ~29.4x FY2027E EPS or faster multi-year margin recovery than our 24.0x base multiple.
